slides.title: Every deal [adds another exception] to your brand.
slides.lede: Serial acquirers need naming rules that survive the next deal, not another founder negotiation.

slides.title: Each acquired name [gets a role]
slides.note: Apply the **same evidence test** to every deal. Allow different outcomes where the evidence differs.

items.title: Perception
items.text: What would clients think had changed?

slides.title: "Everyone knows us" [is not evidence]
slides.text: Founder attachment is evidence of founder attachment. Client value needs separate examination. If a partner's word is all you have, the decision remains unproven.

cards.label: Specialist tax boutique
cards.text: Referrers seek it by name. Keep the acquired name.

cards.label: General advisory practice
cards.text: Loyalty sits with advisers; services overlap. Prepare retirement.

slides.quote: List every operating name, its purpose, its owner and its evidence.
slides.text: Mark the unknowns rather than dressing them up as strategy. Then agree who approves the next exception before a deal decides it for you.

slides.title: Write the naming rules before the next deal.
